help.stock: Name this stock and enter its supplier, received date, and stock expenses.
help.products: Choose an existing product / SKU or create a new one, then record the stock received for that SKU. You can repeat this for as many products as needed.
help.catalog: Choose an existing product / SKU or create a new one, then assign new SKUs to an existing product family when they belong on the same storefront product.
help.record: Record one SKU at a time. Quantity-tracked products use a simple quantity entry; individually tracked products are entered one physical item at a time.
help.review: Check the stock information and all recorded product lines, then save a draft or receive the stock.
help.familyAssignment: Product family is the grouping identity. SKUs in the same family can have different variants and Website prices but will normalize into one storefront product.

validation.catalogRequired: Choose at least one product / SKU for this stock.
validation.conversionPositive: Enter a conversion greater than zero.
validation.familyName: Enter the new product family name.

history.title: Recorded stock
history.description: Current receipts remain available while the new recording flow uses direct product lines.
history.empty: No stock has been recorded yet.
